attack_techniques: Obfuscated Files or Information: Binary Padding (T1027.001)
attackers_goals: An adversary may use binary padding to avoid hash-based blacklists and static antivirus signatures.
description: A suspicious dd command ran and added data to a binary. This may indicate binary padding to change the hash of a file.
investigative_actions: Check the padded file and try to understand the impact of padding this specific binary.
name: Possible binary padding using dd
